revisions.name: $win16_dlg_pump
revisions.reason: Win16 modal keyboard preprocessing resumes a far WM_GETDLGCODE through the existing modal thunk. A zero HWND tags an 80-byte invocation-owned guest-stack frame above the modal record; it contains both MSG layouts and dialog/target generation snapshots. Nested DialogBoxIndirect/EndDialog keeps its own modal and query records. Completion validates both generations, discards the keyboard record before focus or command callbacks, respects DLGC_WANTALLKEYS/WANTTAB/WANTARROWS and suppresses delivery after target retirement. No new global pending keyboard state or nested synchronous run. test/test-win16-windowpos-defproc.js proves ordinary Enter/Escape/Tab/arrows, far requested keys, actual nested modal result99, target destruction, no posted queries and exact restored SP. Original Tetris Enter/F2/Down verification is recorded in run 20261127-tetris-modal-keyboard-fix-root. Broader invocation ownership remains pending.
